forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Even editing directly in RAM from the moment the font is loaded, even changing the address value from 0 or 1 to 3, there were still two problems:
The font wouldn't update because it needs to be loaded into memory, an operation that only the
"Change systemset..."
command can perform.
The font names have only two String addresses, so it wouldn't be possible to push them to make more space.
The only solution would be to install the required fonts in Windows with unusual names and change the name of the first font in memory on the fly and call the "Change Systemset" event only to reload the font in memory.
This requires some technical knowledge, something that I won't do because there's no EULA for the Rm2k Patch, only Rm2k3, which already has its own tools outside the forum.
See an example of basic real-time operation with Rm2k. Unfortunately I was unable to modify the data of the font in use, only the EXFONT:
